qualification_gate: the complete raw source set for the four covered authority kinds matches the exact compiled catalog
every source stable ID, kind, path, catalog digest, and same-session current-byte digest matches
the exact root registry subset matches with no unknown, broad, ambiguous, duplicate, or conflicting row
each canonical target is the exact current canonical definition and remains definition-only
no active canonical implementation exists for the target
the candidate read session revalidates after reconciliation
preserved_truth: the source kind, path, bytes, and stable identity are not changed
no compatibility, equivalence, retirement, readiness, release, or completion claim is raised
N14 migration and N15 retirement obligations remain open
failure_behavior: Any gate failure rejects partial classification, emits pending_authority_verification_failed, and leaves affected active legacy sources under parallel_authority.
registry_rule: Registry prose or membership never proves sole-current status. The current source set, current definitions, current registry rows, and current bytes must pass together in one read session.
claim_ceiling: N02 remains open until independent review, two byte-identical live summaries, exact agent-route reconciliation, and all material inventory findings are reconciled.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim package, install, discovery, runtime, journey, readiness, release, N02 completion, or goal completion.
